d: Long, wavy honey-blonde hair flows past the shoulders with a side-parted fringe. The eyes are a deep sapphire blue with a gentle, smiling expression on a youthful, teenage face. This slender build is dressed in a white collared shirt paired with a navy blue tie, a navy blue skirt, and a matching navy blue cropped jacket with ribbed cuffs, all secured by a black belt with a silver buckle. A miniature grey aircraft is attached to the waist of the skirt.
